title: reading_order
description: A derived unlocking/reading position for a content entity. stage is the simulation round, level_gate the effective level after spoiler deferral; order is the global 1-based position. cost/lane/lock_level expose the legacy iM ordering metric; read_index is the legacy iM readIndex.

timeline_scope.description: Where the row is read: timeline for every iM post and for the seven main characters' OS logs; character for every other OS log, which is listed on its character page by version; none for OA documents and story nodes, which belong to neither list.

stage.description: Reading round. iM posts use the legacy global iM fixpoint (1..N) so their (stage, cost, lane, in_game_order) sequence is the legacy readIndex; other entities use the tier-phased simulation round. 98 is the blocked (outside the model) bucket and 99 an unstaged row.

level_gate.description: Effective level: max(original_level, spoiler gate threshold).

original_level.description: Highest own level lock (0-based); story events inherit their trigger or dependent level.

version.description: OS Category value; null when the entity has no version field.

version_order.description: Numeric parts of version for release-order sorting.

chapter_staged.description: True for test01/test02, the staging chapters a chapter sort pushes last.

in_game_order.description: Stable tie-breaker from the game table order.

cost.description: Unlock cost: the sum of every level lock; a multi-character lock costs the sum of the characters' levels.

lane.description: Account lane: free 0.., paid 100.., side 200.., plot/other 300. Within-stage ordering uses it after cost.

lane_character.description: Character whose account the lane belongs to.

lock_level.description: Highest PAFF/NEKO/ROBO level reached at the row's reading stage.

branch.description: Ending branch semantic code mapped from the story lock (manual provenance); the SPA localizes the display label.

external.description: Why a blocked row sits outside the model (story lock, topic lock, or level/prerequisite).

read_index.description: Legacy iM readIndex (global iM-only sequence); null for non-iM entities.

order.description: Global position in the default (free -> paid -> side) reading order.
